description: Source code for the gl::IndexRangeCache class, which manages caching and invalidation of index ranges used in rendering.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache
classes.description: Class that stores and manages index range data for rendering optimization.

classes.name: IndexRangeCache::IndexRangeKey
classes.description: Key used for indexing cached index ranges, based on draw type, offset, count, and primitive restart flag.

methods.name: addRange
methods.description: Adds an index range to the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: findRange
methods.description: Finds a cached index range matching the specified parameters.

methods.name: invalidateRange
methods.description: Invalidates cached index ranges overlapping a specified range.
